roles.title: Data Engineer
highlights: At Seven Retail Group, home of Sparks and its sister business units, I build and run batch GCP data pipelines with Apache Airflow on Cloud Composer and Docker, land raw data in GCS, and model silver/gold layers in BigQuery with Dataform.

roles.title: Data Engineer Associate II
highlights: At Digital Center of Excellence of Salim Group Company, I built automated, fault-tolerant data pipelines using Airflow, Pub/Sub, Compute Engine, and Google Batch, handling real-time ingestion, distributed processing, and large-scale scraping. I also implemented CI/CD with Docker, built monitoring dashboards in Looker Studio, and ensured data quality for reliable business insights.

roles.title: Data Engineer
highlights: At The Largest Integrated Fisheries Commerce in Indonesia, I built automated ETL workflows with Airflow, integrated data from Google Sheets and PostgreSQL, and transformed large datasets with Pandas and NumPy. I optimized staging layers, loaded data into BigQuery, and ensured accurate insights through Looker Studio dashboards.

roles.title: Software Engineer
highlights: I was involved in a data analytics and monitoring project, developing RESTful APIs with FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Auth0, and building interactive dashboards with Next.js, Mantine UI, React Query, and Chart.js. I containerized services with Docker, managed deployments on a VPS, and set up secure routing with Caddy and Cloudflare.

roles.title: Frontend Developer
highlights: I successfully developed Payment & Insurance features on webview and internal dashboards, enabling transactions on Grab Health via webview in the Grab app. I integrated Sentry for client-side error tracking, making debugging and maintenance more efficient across projects using Next.js, RTK, Redux, Tailwind, TypeScript, and Github Actions.

roles.title: Frontend Developer

I built tools and libraries including an NPX boilerplate generator, cross-platform payment library, and scalable web boilerplates and optimized CI/CD pipelines with GitLab-CI, Nginx, PM2, AWS EC2, and Docker.

roles.title: Jr. Frontend Developer

I also collaborated with the Commerce Tribe to enhance frontend performance for high-traffic e-commerce features.
